subject: orchestrator
parent_objective: Optimize lawful Magmaw 10N bots across every DPS, tank and healer against matched WCL; use exact WoWSims dummy evidence for class diagnosis.

goal_context.parent_objective: Optimize lawful Magmaw 10N bots across every DPS, tank and healer against matched WCL; use exact WoWSims dummy evidence for class diagnosis.
goal_context.current_plan: Continue the coordinator graph through independent review, build, live validation, assessment and publication while preserving every open actor, comparison and raid requirement.

objective: Make incompatible tank/healer reference conditions explicit in role calibration so a non-comparable window is not reported as a class throughput failure, while preserving the numerical floor for comparable records.
first_broken_edge: role_calibration:reference_hard_floor was applied to a Blood tank record whose reference_condition_compatibility was false.
forbidden_changes: No WoWSims/reference data, Blood SQL, native comparator, coefficients, gear, encounter behavior, route or safety policy changes.
No actor or raid acceptance from this contract result.
No removal of Heart Strike fallback or multi-target Blood Boil behavior.
acceptance_conditions: An incompatible tank record reports reference_conditions_not_comparable and does not report reference_hard_floor as the cause.
A comparable tank record still applies and passes the configured numerical floor.
All tank-specific safety and threat checks remain enforced.
proposed_change: Add an explicit non-DPS reference-comparability branch to evaluate_calibration and cover incompatible and compatible tank records with a focused regression test.
acceptance_claim: The focused Python contract tests pass; live Blood behavior, actor performance and raid acceptance remain unproved.
observations: The implementation changes only tools/bot_ml/role_calibration_harness.py and adds tests/test_tank_calibration_reference_contract.py.
Incompatible tank/healer reference conditions now make the numerical floor and optimization target inapplicable and add reference_conditions_not_comparable as the explicit failure.
Comparable tank/healer records retain reference_comparison_eligible and the existing reference_hard_floor calculation.
The focused tests pass 22 total cases with the existing DPS gate suite; the phase7 role harness contract test also passes.

evidence_excerpts.excerpt: Non-DPS records with explicit conditions_compatible=false skip the numerical floor, record reference_conditions_not_comparable, and retain all tank/healer role checks.
The test exercises both incompatible and comparable tank records and asserts the explicit classification and retained floor.
Blood tank run target_count=6, ratio=0.552016; every tank check passed and the only prior failure was reference_hard_floor.
